vocabulary.example: This semester I have five classes.

vocabulary.meaning_en: making you want to know more
a person who works in science
vocabulary.example: Do you want to be a scientist?

vocabulary.meaning_en: school work you do at home
vocabulary.example: Do you have any homework today?
Why do you want this job?

vocabulary.meaning_en: people who buy things in a shop

fine_lines.title: What do you do? vs What do you want to be?
words: What do you want to be?
fine_lines.explanation_ar: What do you do? تسأل عن عملك الآن. What do you want to be? تسأل عن المهنة التي تريدها في المستقبل.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "What do you do?" = your job now. "What do you want to be?" = your future job.

examples.sentence: What do you do? I'm a nurse.

examples.word: What do you want to be?
examples.sentence: What do you want to be? I want to be a teacher.

fine_lines.title: skills vs experience
fine_lines.explanation_ar: skills هي الأشياء التي تُجيدها، و experience هي ما تعلمته من عمل سابق.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Skills = what you can do well. Experience = what you learned from past work.

examples.sentence: I can speak English and Spanish. Those are my skills.
I worked in a shop. That is good experience.

expressions.phrase: Are your classes interesting this semester?
expressions.example: Are your classes interesting this semester? Yes, they are!

expressions.phrase: What do you want to be?
expressions.example: What do you want to be? I want to be a doctor.

expressions.phrase: Let's help each other after school!
expressions.example: You have math homework too? Let's help each other after school!

expressions.phrase: Why do you want this job?
expressions.example: Why do you want this job? I like working with people.
What are your skills? I am friendly and organized.

expressions.phrase: When can you start? — I can start next Monday.
expressions.meaning_ar: متى يمكنك البدء؟ — أستطيع البدء يوم الاثنين القادم.
expressions.example: When can you start? I can start tomorrow.

expressions.meaning_en: What an interviewer says at the end.
expressions.example: Thank you for coming. We will call you soon.
Exercise in the morning makes me feel good.

expressions.phrase: I want to try it sometime.
expressions.meaning_ar: أريد أن أجرّبه في وقت ما.
expressions.meaning_en: Say you are interested in trying.
expressions.example: Swimming looks fun. I want to try it sometime.

grammar.title: want to be + job
grammar.explanation_ar: نتحدث عن المهنة المستقبلية بـ want to be + a/an + المهنة: I want to be a teacher.
grammar.explanation_en: Use want to be + a/an + job for future plans.
examples: I want to be a teacher.
Do you want to be a scientist?
She wants to be a nurse.

grammar.title: can for ability and permission
grammar.explanation_ar: can + الفعل للقدرة (I can speak English) أو للقدرة على موعد (I can start next Monday). والسؤال: Can you work on weekends?
grammar.explanation_en: can + base verb for ability. Question: Can you...?
examples: I can speak English and Spanish.
Can you work on weekends? Yes, I can.

grammar.title: Past simple for experience
grammar.explanation_ar: نتحدث عن خبرة سابقة بالماضي البسيط: I worked in a shop. I helped customers.
grammar.explanation_en: Use the past simple to talk about past work.
examples: Last week, we watched a video about space.
